reviews.t: Just What the Guest Room Needed

Other reviews give us confidence that these are good products at a reasonable price that our guests will enjoy.

claims.text: Many reviewers love the scent, describing it as a lovely lavender fragrance.
Reviewers frequently say it leaves hair soft, shiny, and hydrated.
Several reviewers praise it for brightening blonde, silver, or gray hair, though a few say it did not reduce brassiness or brighten their gray.
Some reviewers value that it is sulfate-free and free of harmful ingredients.
A few reviewers complain about price or value, and one raises a hair-loss lawsuit concern.
